items.headline: Kyiv: North Korea ki KN-23 missile ka istemal
items.detail: Zelenskyy ke mutabik prarambhik jaanch me ek key energy site par North Korea ki KN-23 missile mili; raat bhar chali 36 missiles me se sirf 4 roki gayin.
items.exam_angle: Russia-North Korea sainya sahyog aur pratibandh — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Houthi: Riyadh airport, Aramco par hamle ka daava
items.detail: Houthiyon ne 6 missile-drone hamlo ka daava kiya — Riyadh airport aur Aramco sites nishane par; Saudi ne abhi pushti nahi ki, daave ki swatantra pushti nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: Paschim Asia sangharsh aur tel suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump: Democrats ki jaanch ka aadesh
items.detail: Trump ne Justice Department ko Democrats ki jaanch ka aadesh diya, aarop hai ki ve mahaabhiyog ki dhamki dekar 'dabaav' bana rahe hain; unhone koi saboot nahi diya.
items.exam_angle: America me midterm ke baad satta santulan aur Congress ki nigrani — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Sanaa: Hawai hamle me 27 ki maut
items.detail: Sanaa ke paas al-Shariya gaon par hawai hamle me Houthi-run health ministry ke anusar kam se kam 27 ki maut aur 36 ghayal hue; Houthis ne Saudi Arabia par aarop lagaya, Riyadh ne abhi koi tippani nahi ki.
items.exam_angle: Yemen grih yuddh aur Saudi-Houthi sangharsh — Madhya Purv ki suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Qeshm-Jask: Hormuz kinare phir dhamake
items.detail: Iran ke sarkari media ke anusar Qeshm dweep aur Jask, Sirik aur Bandar Abbas me dhamakon ki awaazein suni gayin; wajah abhi saaf nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz jalmarg aur America-Iran tanav — antarrashtriya suraksha aur urja ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Israel: Eisenkot ko sarkar banane ka mauka
items.detail: Rashtrapati Isaac Herzog ne Netanyahu ke pratidvandi Gadi Eisenkot ko sarkar banane ka mauka diya; 67 sansadon ne unka samarthan kiya, Netanyahu ko 46 mile, aur Eisenkot ke paas 28 din hain.
items.exam_angle: Israel me sarkar gathan aur Knesset ki bhoomika — Madhya Purv ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Ronen Horesh / Knesset Archives, CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: CENTCOM: Iran ki zameeni supply par rok
items.detail: America ki Central Command ne Task Force Iron Gate banayi hai jo Iran ki zameeni seemaon aur Caspian Sea se hathiyaron aur pratibandhit saaman ki aavaajahi rokegi.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav me nakabandi ka vistaar — Hormuz aur samudri vyapar ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Paraguay: Peña prosecutors ke saamne pesh hue
items.detail: Ueno Bank ke collapse par Senate ne Peña ko hataya tha; house arrest ke baad woh shanivaar subah Attorney General ke saamne pesh hue, Alliana naye rashtrapati ban chuke hain.
items.exam_angle: Mahabhiyog aur banking sankat — governance aur vittiya niyaman ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Presidencia de Ecuador, public domain (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: America: Dhillon ne Civil Rights pad chhoda
items.detail: Trump prashasan ki pehli badi vidai — Attorney General ne 5 November ko Harmeet Dhillon ka istifa sweekar kiya; woh April 2025 se Civil Rights Division ki pramukh thi.
items.exam_angle: Midterm ke baad pehli badi vidai — America ki rajneeti aur nagrik adhikar ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: France: School bus haadse me do ki maut
items.detail: Lyon se Bourg-en-Bresse ja rahi bus ped se takra gayi; saat saal ki ladki aur 18 saal ke yuva ki maut, 16 ghayal, teen ki haalat gambhir.

items.headline: New Zealand: Chunav me koi vijeta nahi
items.detail: National ko 42 aur Labour ko 36 seatein mili; Labour ko vote share me halki badhat, lekin sarkar ka faisla 27 November ke aadhikarik natije par tika.
items.exam_angle: MMP chunav pranali aur hung parliament — loktantra ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Colombia: Drone hamle me teen sainik mare
items.detail: Santa Rosa del Sur ke sainya adde par visfotak drones se hamla — teen sainikon ki maut, aath gambhir ghayal; hamle ki zimmedari kisi ne nahi li.
items.exam_angle: Drone yuddh aur Latin America ki suraksha — aadhunik yuddh takneek ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Japan: 5.7 ke bhookamp me 22 ghayal
items.detail: Subah 1:04 baje Shizuoka ke paas 5.7 tivra bhookamp se Aichi aur Shizuoka me kam se kam 22 log ghayal hue; tsunami ki chetavni nahi, Hamaoka parmanu plant surakshit raha.
items.exam_angle: Japan ki bhookamp-prone sthiti aur aapda taiyari — bhugol aur aapda prabandhan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America: Iran parmanu suchna par $20m inaam
items.detail: Rewards for Justice ne Iran ke parmanu karyakram ki jankari par 20 million dollar tak ka inaam aur sambhav sthanantaran ki ghoshna ki; IAEA ke anusar Iran 60% tak uranium samriddh kar raha hai.
items.exam_angle: IAEA safeguards aur parmanu aprasar — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America: Miller naye chief of staff bane
items.detail: Trump ne Stephen Miller ko White House chief of staff banaya; woh somvaar se pad sambhalenge, Susie Wiles ab Trump ke political operation me jayengi.
items.exam_angle: Midterm ke baad White House me bada badlav — America ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Krakow: Chauk par golibari, chhah ki maut
items.detail: Krakow ke Main Market Square par hamalawar ne gaadi se golibari ki — chhah ki maut, 15 ghayal; police ne use goli maarkar giraftar kiya. Uske ghar par parivar ke teen sadasyon ke shav mile; mantri ke anusar woh kattar dakshinpanthi vichardhara se prabhavit tha. (Updated: pehle paanch ki maut batayi gayi thi.)

items.headline: Oman ki khaadi: America ne jahaz ko roka
items.detail: CENTCOM ke mutaabik, M/V Huda ne naaka todne ki koshish ki to America ne uske pichhle hisse par hamla kar use roka.
items.exam_angle: Iran par America ki samudri naakaabandi July se jaari hai

items.headline: Abu Dhabi vaarta: Russia ki team taya
items.detail: Kremlin ne kaha, Medinsky ke netritva me Ryabkov pehli baar shamil honge; 10-11 November ko America-Ukraine ke saath vaarta hogi.
items.exam_angle: February ke baad pehli tripakshiya vaarta

items.headline: France: Chauthe hafte bhi sadkon par virodh
items.detail: Grih mantralaya ke mutaabik Shanivaar ko 1.46 lakh log mehengaai aur vetan ke khilaaf sadkon par utre.
items.exam_angle: France me paanch mahine me rashtrapati chunav

items.headline: Gaza: Baarish me 70,000 tent doobe
items.detail: Sardi ki pehli baarish me 12 ghante me 70,000 tent doob gaye aur civil defence ko 1,500 madad ki pukaarein mili.

items.headline: Oman ki khaadi: UAE ne 22 log bachaye
items.detail: Oman ki khaadi me maalvahak jahaz me aag lagne par UAE National Guard ne 22 arab nagrikon ko bachaya; sabhi sthir haalat me hain.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz ke aas-paas samudri suraksha — antarrashtriya vyapar ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Syria: Yemen sainik bhejne se inkaar
items.detail: Damascus ne kaha Yemen ko sainik bhejne ki khabrein bebuniyad hain; Saudi se sahyog sirf prashikshan aur salah tak simit rahega.
items.exam_angle: Mecca Pact aur Madhya Purv me badalti Saudi-Syria dosti — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America: Iraq se Iran seema band karne ko kaha
items.detail: America ne Iraq se kaha Iran ke saath sirf do seema crossing khule rakhe; Tehran-samarthak milicia ke samarthan par sainya karravai ki chetavni bhi di.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav me Iraq ki bhoomika — Madhya Purv ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Italy: Mantri ka data dark web par
items.detail: Videsh Mantri Tajani ne kaha Russia-samarthak hackers ne unka niji data dark web par daala; Ukraine samarthan ko wajah bataya, Moscow ne tippani nahi ki.
items.exam_angle: Hybrid warfare aur cyber suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Canada: 2027 tak 6.22 lakh PR
items.detail: Budget 2026 ke tahat Canada 2027 tak 6,22,000 naye permanent residents ko jagah dega, jinme 2 lakh asthayi nivasi bhi shamil hain.
items.exam_angle: Canada ki immigration policy aur Bharatiya pravasi — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.
